[12 regression] Incorrect destructor calls after array-new-expression sincer12-6328-gbeaee0a871b648
Createdattachment 59736[details]Test code

Starting with gcc-12, the following code is miscompiled (duplicate destructor calls, causing use-after-free):https://godbolt.org/z/3GTd4vYTj(also attached)

If a C constructor throws, the previously already initialized array elements need to be destroyed; but once the array is completely initialized and the new-expression has completed, other exceptions later in the full expression should not call any C destructors.
